title: Budgets, Rate Limits and Usage Controls
summary: LLM spend scales with usage, and usage can spike or run away. This lesson covers the token bucket, provider rate limits, per-tenant quotas, cost forecasting and the alerts and kill switches that keep a bill predictable.
objectives: Simulate a token bucket by hand and state the maximum admitted in any window as b + rT
Budget requests against requests-per-minute and tokens-per-minute limits and handle 429 responses
Allocate shared capacity fairly across tenants with weights and max-min fairness
Forecast monthly spend from usage, token distributions and growth
Set spend alerts from burn rate and design kill switches for runaway loops
prerequisites: You should know how to cost a request from token counts ([Choosing and Routing Models](/learn/production-systems/model-routing)) and what a 429 response and backoff are ([Fallbacks and Graceful Degradation](/learn/production-systems/fallbacks)).
